summary: Day one went the risk-off way. SPY closed at 732.44, down 1.01% from 739.95, and is now only 0.39% above the 729.58 200-day line, so VOO (-1.06%) and VTI (-1.19%) are NEAR their shared stop. That one session already uses up the whole +/-1% neutral band, but the stance is graded on 5 sessions and Nvidia reports after today's close, so nothing is settled. The cross-asset picture did not ease: on shadow fill prices BTC (~-1.3%), ETH (~-1.3%) and VNQ (~-1.4%) fell with stocks, so the broad de-risking I described went on. The sector tilts held up only in part. Staples sheltered (DPZ +1.0%, SAM +0.6%, KR +0.2%), but WMT fell 0.83% ahead of its 11-19 print, and the Financials tilt did badly: MCO -4.32% and MSCI -4.20%, the worst names in the book. Health Care was mixed (EXEL +2.09%, INCY -0.98%, IDXX -1.49%). FAST, the Industrials name I said to avoid, fell 1.22%.
broken_theses: Financials as a favored tilt: XLF's +0.33% 5-day and 8.36% above its 200-day did not protect the financial-data names. MCO -4.32% and MSCI -4.20% on a -1.01% SPY day. One day and two names, not XLF itself, but the tilt did not work as shelter today. MCO is 3.07% above its $470 stop.
Staples as a uniform shelter: WMT fell 0.83% while the other Staples names rose, so the factor did not move as one block going into WMT's 11-19 print.
update: Keep risk-off going into tomorrow unless Nvidia's after-hours reaction puts QQQ back above its 200-day and lifts SPY more than 1%, which is the trigger I set in this morning's watch list. With SPY 0.39% above its 200-day, the regime filter and the VOO/VTI stop could both trip on one ordinary down day. Tomorrow's note should state that plainly to the PM and not repeat 'do not add' as if there were room. Tomorrow I will re-check Financials against XLF's own 5-day number before keeping it on the favor list. If XLF follows MCO and MSCI lower, I will drop it and narrow the favor list to Consumer Staples and Health Care. Today's close.json does not show cross-asset closes for TLT, HYG, UUP, GLD or VIXY, so the 'cushions failing' thesis gets its next check from tomorrow's packet. I have not judged it today beyond the crypto and VNQ shadow prices.
